summary: The working-tree change correctly handles absent committed reference tables: it reports reproduction failure, falls back to an available regenerated table for extraction, and exits nonzero. I found no defect likely to change a number or claim; the main remaining gap is that the real paper-repository integration could not be exercised.

verified_clean.item: Missing committed references no longer cause an uncaught read or hash failure.
verified_clean.evidence: replication/extract_deaglan_tables.py:67-75 checks both regenerated and committed paths before hashing, records failure, and continues safely.

verified_clean.item: The extraction fallback uses the regenerated table while preserving a failing exit status.
verified_clean.evidence: replication/extract_deaglan_tables.py:138-148 sets `failed = True`, requires an existing regenerated file, and assigns that file as the text and diagnostic reference; lines 165-178 validate/extract it and exit 1. In-memory filesystem tests confirmed exit 1 without exceptions when committed references were missing.

verified_clean.item: The existing all-present workflow remains successful.
verified_clean.evidence: replication/extract_deaglan_tables.py:149-176 retains committed-reference extraction and regenerated-text comparison. An in-memory all-files-present test completed with exit 0 and unchanged targets.

verified_clean.item: Missing files and malformed table structure cannot be presented as successful reproduction.
verified_clean.evidence: replication/extract_deaglan_tables.py:67-83 marks either absent input as failure; lines 101-107 require exactly one ordered `tabular` environment; line 178 returns nonzero whenever failure was recorded.

verified_clean.item: The implementation matches the dispositioned review finding that motivated it.
verified_clean.evidence: review/reports/2026-11-18_123911-067b885_..067b885-agy.md:17 and :40 require missing-reference guards plus regenerated-file fallback, implemented at replication/extract_deaglan_tables.py:71-75 and :138-148.

verified_clean.item: The modified Python source is syntactically valid and the diff has no whitespace errors.
verified_clean.evidence: AST parsing of replication/extract_deaglan_tables.py succeeded, and `git diff --check HEAD` reported no errors.

review_limits: No paper draft was supplied, so manuscript claims could not be compared with the code.

The external paper repository and regenerated linkage tables were unavailable inside the workspace; behavior was checked statically and with an in-memory filesystem simulation rather than the real integration.
The external census/linkage data and Stata pipeline were not run, so no empirical table values were independently reproduced.
The untracked review reports were read as audit artifacts; their historical source-level conclusions were not treated as fresh evidence about unavailable external data.
